title: Coming Out
summary: Coming out is sharing your sexual orientation or gender identity with others. It's personal and ongoing; you decide who to tell, when, and whether it's safe.
key_points: Safety comes first, especially in unsupportive families.
Trusted friends or LGBTQ+ support groups can help.
answer_guidance: Explain factually and non-graphically in the user's language (English, Banglish or Bengali). Start with a simple definition and add detail only if asked. Be non-judgemental; mention consent, safety or seeing a doctor only where genuinely relevant.
